sys_script_include.description:
Material Fulfillment Decision Engine — 20-step multi-warehouse fulfillment strategy evaluator.
Determines the safest and fastest fulfillment strategy across three warehouses. Creates a recommendation record in x_2056099_indust_0_fulfill_dec. READ-ONLY: does NOT modify inventory, orders, or transfers.
Decision types: LOCAL_AVAILABLE_STOCK, LOCAL_SAFETY_STOCK, INTER_WAREHOUSE_TRANSFER, PROCUREMENT_LOCAL_SUPPLIER, PROCUREMENT_ALTERNATE_WAREHOUSE_SUPPLIER, RESERVED_STOCK_REALLOCATION, MANUAL_REVIEW, UNFULFILLABLE
Usage: var engine = new x_2056099_indust_0.MaterialFulfillmentDecision(); var result = engine.evaluate({ materialSysId: "...", quantityRequired: 100, warehouseSysId: "...", customerRequiredDate: "2026-10-15 00:00:00", customerOrderSysId: "...", productionOrderSysId: "..." });
sys_script_include.name: MaterialFulfillmentDecision
